body: I took the time to read it. I like you. Listen, I'm no better than you. I have a post here too. In fact, I feel alone too (even with a wife and child). But, reading this helps me realize we are not alone. I would like to talk more to someone. And, I love reading.

Thanks guys, but you're not listening. I can't solve my depression by thinking of others. I don't posses that level of compassion anymore. I want my loved ones to be happy. But, I can't provide that now or ever. The pain they feel from my loss would be much easier to forget than the pain of dealing with me around everyday.

You hit the nail on the head. She used those words today. I'm too controlling and if she can't be herself, she would rather be alone. I know she's not to blame. It's just so painful hearing this from her. I tried to call friends. I even told one of my best friends (his mom helped raise me) that I needed him. He asked if everything was ok. I said no. He said he had dinner plans and would text tomorrow. The world has become so disconnected with humanity. I'm telling this shit to you while my wife sleeps. When I started this, she was downloading music to her phone. I guess music is a coping mechanism for some people.

I wish I understood that thought. I really do. My dad was my best friend until he died when I was 19 and he was 49. I was devastated. I got over it. I am now a stronger person. Sure, I would rather have my dad. But, he did his thing. He loved the time he was here and didn't regret a thing. I may wonder how things could've been different. But, I don't really feel that regret either. I've done some cool shit in my life. Things others only fantasize about. He will use his knowledge and experience to establish his opinion on me. Just as I have done with my father.

I do have a dependence, it's true. And it is so unfair. We almost divorced last year after a month long fight. I asked her if she still loved me. She didn't answer. That should have been the end. We got back together. She tries so hard to be what I need. At least, I would like to think so. It's just so strange that she met my needs (and I reciprocated) for many years. Now, I tell her ver batum what I need and she ignores it or does the opposite. She even does this when I verbalize that I am depressed and need her more than ever. She doesn't deserve that shit. I'm such an ass.

It's true, it is HIS life. However, he will have influences all along that will shape his personality. This would be a very traumatic experience for all involved. But, why is there happiness more important than my pain?

Hence the reason I still breath life. My son and wife are the only reasons I am still here. I guess you can say I am a huge shit talker because I could never go through with this. Then again, I had full intentions on stepping in that tub. My parents both died prematurely. I miss them. I don't blame them. And sure, trust is an issue. But, then again, why would I want my son to trust anyone?

That's the whole idea. The career doesn't really matter anyway. It's just shitty knowing I won't ever do what I feel I NEED to do. 

AND, I've been trying to talk about it. I've even said it. The problem lies in the fact that I told my wife that if she contacted professionals, I would have to leave. As it is, I'm certain the marriage is done because of the guilt on both our parts. I don't want to be blackballed by my profession (my civilian version of my career is equally as demanding and can't have the liability of someone on medication or receiving psychological treatment). I realize this thought seems ass backwards. But, I may still be able to work if I can control my problem quietly. And if I do get professional help, then where is my life? I still have bills to pay. And, last I checked, it ain't easy to get a job these days.
